title: aleatorios: a random number on request
summary: A child that answers each SIGUSR1 with a random number through a pipe.
hints: Install the `SIGUSR1` handler BEFORE the `fork` (the child inherits it), so a signal sent early cannot kill the child. The handler writes the number to the pipe with `write` (`rand() % 11`; a number of two digits is only `10`).

The child seeds with `srand(getpid())` and then loops on `pause()`. The parent, per input line, does `kill(child, SIGUSR1)` and `read`s the reply before asking the next time; at the end it sends `SIGTERM` and waits.
